proposal.reason: Main change is CI workflow execution logic: .github/workflows/build-artifactory-ppu.yml adds authenticated docker/login-action before image pulls, and all three workflows now resolve t-head/pccl-tests from a branch paired to github ref with retry/fallback to main, then propagate resolved sha/branch through checkout, runner-revision, and cache probe/publish paths. .github/xtest/artifact_cache.py and test_workflow_contract.py only align fixture-label checks with that runtime resolution. This is owned by ci (test workflow selection/execution/reporting), not workflow policy automation.
